new_primary_conclusions.title: Statistical Applications of the Poisson-Binomial and Conditional Bernoulli Distributions
verified_facts: Independent Bernoullis conditioned on their total count define the conditional Bernoulli model (p.875).
Eq3 is a product of weights restricted to fixed-size binary patterns, with their exact summed product normalizer; weights are proportional to Bernoulli odds (p.876).
Eq6 defines the sum of products over k-subsets; this is the ESP normalizer (p.877).
Method2/Eq9 and the following cell recursion add exclusion and weighted inclusion contributions. The article states O(nN) recurrence work (pp.876,878).
new_primary_conclusions.relationship: The proposed single-side law is exactly this attributed fixed-cardinality family with log weights provided by graph neural scorers. Uniform mixtures and two-side coupling are further classical mixture constructions; this read does not verify a particular earlier identical graph application.
limitations: No historical-priority claim for this paper
Earlier works cited by this paper are not separately primary-read
No neural-mixture/graph application claim in the consulted scope
